title: Set up marketplace seller onboarding and payouts
summary: When a platform connects buyers and independent sellers or service providers and allocates payments between parties. A reviewed seller-to-payment operating model with tested onboarding, reconciliation and payout exception handling.
outcomes: A reviewed seller-to-payment operating model with tested onboarding, reconciliation and payout exception handling.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a platform connects buyers and independent sellers or service providers and allocates payments between parties.

parts.title: Map the parties and flow of funds
parts.guidance: Document the buyer, seller, platform, payment provider and each intended charge, fee, refund and payout. Separate contractual responsibilities from proposed technical account relationships.

references.title: Stripe Connect marketplace account and payment model

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Approve the marketplace operating model
parts.guidance: Qualified advisers and the provider confirm permitted activities, account responsibilities, verification needs and loss exposure. Pause unsupported jurisdictions or funds flows rather than assuming a processor removes regulatory obligations.

references.title: Stripe Connect marketplace account and payment model

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Prepare seller intake and exception records
parts.guidance: Define required seller evidence, verification status, payout destinations and escalation owners. Design access controls and a private record of changes without storing sensitive seller documents in the open repository.

references.title: Stripe Connect marketplace account and payment model

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Configure the approved account integration
parts.guidance: An authorized operator configures onboarding, permissions and payment flows in the provider test environment. Use the currently supported integration and protect credentials and bank-account changes.

references.title: Stripe Connect marketplace account and payment model

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Test settlement and failure scenarios
parts.guidance: Finance and engineering verify commissions, refunds, disputes, failed verification and payout failures against sample ledgers. Require approval before enabling a seller whose verification or account status is unresolved.

references.title: Stripe Connect marketplace account and payment model

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Release approved sellers and reconcile operations
parts.guidance: Authorized operators activate only approved sellers and payment capabilities. Reconcile settlements to seller balances and retain exception ownership; production payouts need their own transaction-specific authorization.

references.title: Stripe Connect marketplace account and payment model
